within Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Reals;
block Ramp "Limit the changing rate of the input"

  parameter Real raisingSlewRate(
    min=Constants.small,
    unit="1/s")
    "Maximum speed with which to increase the output";
  parameter Real fallingSlewRate(
    max=-Constants.small,
    unit="1/s")=-raisingSlewRate
    "Maximum speed with which to decrease the output";
  parameter Real Td(
    final quantity="Time",
    final unit="s",
    min=Constants.eps)=raisingSlewRate*0.001
    "Derivative time constant";

  Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Interfaces.RealInput u
    "Input that is being rate limited"
    annotation (Placement(transformation(extent={{-140,-20},{-100,20}})));
  Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Interfaces.BooleanInput active
    "Set to true to enable rate limiter"
    annotation (Placement(transformation(extent={{-140,-100},{-100,-60}}),
        iconTransformation(extent={{-140,-100},{-100,-60}})));
  Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Interfaces.RealOutput y
    "Rate limited output if active is true, else output is equal to input"
    annotation (Placement(transformation(extent={{100,-20},{140,20}})));

protected
  Real thr=(u-y)/Td

results.title: Update CDL.Reals.Ramp documentation
results.body: This issue is to update the `CDL.Reals.Ramp` documentation, to highlight its similarity and difference with the block `CDL.Reals.LimitSlewRate`.

results.title: Modify CDL blocks based on ASHRAE 231P discussion
results.body:
This issue is to update/add existing/new blocks in `Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL` package, based on the discussion in ASHRAE 231P project.


1. Existing blocks to be updated:
    - [x] `CDL.Continuous.Add` and `CDL.Integers.Add`: do not have a gain factor for inputs, only add two input values 

2. Existing blocks to be renamed:
    - [x] change `CDL.Continuous.Division` to `CDL.Continuous.Divide`
    - [x] change `CDL.Continuous.Gain` to `CDL.Continuous.MultiplyByParameter`
    - [x] change `CDL.Continuous.MovingMean` to `CDL.Continuous.MovingAverage`
    - [x] change `CDL.Continuous.Product` to `CDL.Continuous.Multiply`
    - [x] change `CDL.Integers.Product` to `CDL.Integers.Multiply`
    - [x] change `CDL.Continuous.SlewRateLimiter` to `CDL.Continuous.LimitSlewRate`

3. New blocks to be added:
    - [x] `CDL.Continuous.Acos`
    - [x] `CDL.Continuous.Asin`
    - [x] `CDL.Continuous.Subtract`
    - [x] `CDL.Integers.Subtract`

4. Move existing blocks:
    - [x] move `CDL.Continuous.Feedback` to folder `Buildings.Obsolete.Controls.OBC.CDL.Continuous`
    - [x] move the old `CDL.Continuous.Add` and `CDL.Integers.Add` to folder `Buildings.Obsolete.Controls.OBC.CDL.Continuous` and `Buildings.Obsolete.Controls.OBC.CDL.Integers`

results.title: Refactor Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Psychrometrics
results.body:
The blocks
`Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Psychrometrics.TDewPoi_TDryBulPhi`
`Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Psychrometrics.TWetBul_TDryBulPhi`
take as an input `p`, which is not used. This can be removed.

The block
`Buildings.Controls.OBC.CDL.Psychrometrics.h_TDryBulPhi`
takes as an input p, this should be removed and instead an parameter `pAtm = 101325` should be used, with annotation `tab=Advanced`.

To distinguish them from the blocks with the same name in `Buildings.Utilities`, we may want to move them to `Obsolete` and rename them to `DewPoint_TDryBulPhi`, `WetBulb_TDryBulPhi` and `SpecificEnthalpy_TDryBulPhi`.
